# gitmoap_group_mr_settings (Data Source)

Get MR settings for a group (raw values, no inheritance resolution). The values this group sets itself, each absent where the group leaves it to the groups above; nothing is filled in from them. Anyone who can see the group may read them.

The token needs `mr_settings:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_mr_settings" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Read-Only

- `allow_merge_without_pipeline` (Boolean) While `require_pipeline_success` is on: whether a merge request that no pipeline applies to
may merge. Absent inherits.
- `block_on_rejection` (Boolean)
- `delete_source_branch_default` (Boolean)
- `merge_method` (String)
- `override_group_settings` (Boolean)
- `require_issue_criteria_green` (Boolean)
- `require_linked_issue` (Boolean)
- `require_pipeline_success` (Boolean) Block the merge until every pipeline that applies to the merge request's head has
succeeded. Absent inherits.
- `squash_option` (String)
- `stack_auto_retarget` (Boolean)
- `stack_enforce_merge_order` (Boolean)
- `stack_restack_strategy` (String)
- `unresolved_threads` (Boolean)
